newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Group 4 wins prison movement contract.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Group 4 wins prison movement contract.

text.p: Group 4 Correction Services has been selected to privately manage prison and young offender movements and in-court management in South Australia, the state government said on Monday.
Group 4 director Stephen Twinn told Reuters he was not permitted to disclose the value of the five-year contract.
Group 4 currently operates South Australia's only privately managed prison at Mount Gambier and is involved in the privately built and run Men's Metropolitan Prison in Victoria.
The company is the Australian subsidiary of the privately owned Dutch-based Group 4 International BV, which also operates prisons in the United Kingdom.
